name: SHG
note: Sponsor of NEOM SC (2026-27 home kit) and race presenting partner of the Saudi Cup meeting; exact legal name unconfirmed. Not on Al-Nassr's 2026-27 home kit: the club's front-of-shirt spaces went to HUMAIN (main) and Gathern (upper chest), and the official Saudi Pro League kit photo shows no SHG. The 433FC season listing that had SHG as an Al-Nassr second front sponsor also gives KAFD as main sponsor, which the HUMAIN announcement (PR Newswire, 2026-07-28) superseded.
